messages:
kevin: FYI following last night's regression postmortem — can we lock owners/timeline for the SLO changes? p95 breach on generation paths, recurring KVCache stall pattern noted.

maria: +1. From the postmortem action list I pulled: reduce default batch size, add adaptive throttling, and dashboard slices for per-model latency. We need owners for each.

kevin: propose owners: lia -> dashboards, jack -> throttling implementation, kevin -> batching config + runbook updates. Tentative ETAs: lia 48h, jack 5 business days, kevin 72h.

lia: I can update dashboards. Which panels do you want? I'll add per-route p50/p95/p99, QPS, and an error-budget burn-rate widget. Need list of routes and model tags.

jack: I'll take throttling. Plan is an adaptive queue-length-based throttle + a soft cap for long-context requests. First step is repro in staging — who can share traces?

kevin: Trace link: http://go/trace/INC-2026-442 (postmortem has full traces). Affected routes: /v1/generate (long sequences) and /v1/chat (multi-turn). Current p95 target is 150ms generally; on long-context requests we saw p95 ~320ms. Proposal: carve out large-context SLO: p95 250ms, keep regular routes at 150ms. Thoughts?

maria: Changing SLOs requires SLO governance sign-off. For now we can mark a temporary exception for bursty long-context traffic and run mitigations. I'll open an SLO-change ticket and loop in ops & product.

lia: created dash ticket #3456 to add the panels and the error-budget widget, plus a per-model filter. ETA 48h. Will add an "incidents by root cause" tag to tie to postmortems.

jack: for the throttle, I'm leaning adaptive based on in-flight queue + K/V cache hit ratio. Prototype today, PR within 5 business days. Will post staging repro steps here.

kevin: owners summary for the postmortem: lia (dashboards) - due +2d, jack (adaptive throttle) - PR +5bd, kevin (batching config & runbook) - +3d, maria (SLO governance + ticket) - today. Can we sync tomorrow 11:00 UTC? @oncall-bot set reminder.

oncall-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-24 11:00 UTC.

maria: Also proposing an automated recurrence check: alert if the same root cause (kv-cache stall) appears in 3 incidents within 90d. Lia, can you add that to the dashboard/alerts?

lia: Ack — will add an alert query for repeated postmortem tags and a link to the rollback/playbook snippet. Adding runbook link to the dash as well.

kevin: I'll update the postmortem with owners, expected completion dates, and the SLO exception note. One more: error budget reset? I propose we do NOT reset — the burn is real and helps prioritize fixes. @maria?

maria: Agree — don't reset. We'll track burn and re-evaluate after mitigations. Schedule a 2-week follow-up to confirm recurrence suppression and validate the new dashboard metrics.

kevin: Great. Action items for tomorrow's sync: confirm dash wireframes, throttle design doc, batching config PR status, and SLO-change ticket progress. Closing thread for now, will post updates in the ticket threads. Thanks all :thumbsup:
